verdict.rationale: HelixDB publishes an OpenAPI spec on its docs site and documents its HTTP API (`POST /v2/query`), so a machine-readable API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that the reference is interactive or offers in-browser runnable examples; the closest is the quickstart's generated JSON request run against a local instance. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer or playground, runnable examples within the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.helix-db.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
The HelixDB HTTP API accepts operation-tree queries at `POST /v2/query`.
You will create a project, start the generated `dev` instance, run the generated JSON request, and stop the instance.
